purpose: Accelerate S0 development without waiting days by using public historical race pages that preserve race-specific pre-race fields and final outcome labels, while preventing post-race leakage into PRE features.
observed_capability_2026_09_01: historical pages expose race date, venue, race number, scheduled start and betting close
historical pages expose rider identity, class, style, competition score, S, B, nige, makuri, sashi, mark and recent-rate fields
result view exposes final finish order on the same race-specific page
same-meeting next-day pages expose prior-day race result in a historical-results section, consistent with race-local historical context
critical_semantics_gate: Do not assume every displayed field is frozen as-of race time merely because the page is historical. First run a source-semantics pilot across repeated riders/days and reject any PRE field that appears to be dynamically recomputed using post-race/future information.

checks: PRE table values are race-specific and stable across result/odds pageType variants for the same race
same rider on consecutive meeting days does not show impossible future-day information in the earlier day's PRE section
previous-race history on day N includes only races before day N
result fields are parsed only into labels, never into PRE feature namespace

development_sampling.target: 200 to 500 races quickly from contiguous historical dates before 2026-09-02
development_sampling.membership: freeze date/venue/race inclusion before model fitting on the sample
development_sampling.same_meeting_leakage: preserve chronological order; day2/day3 may use only information genuinely available before that day's race

relationship_to_20260902: Historical fast-track may supply the initial S0 coefficients before 2026-09-02 scoring only if the semantics pilot passes and coefficient fitting is locked before any 2026-09-02 target outcomes are observed. Otherwise 2026-09-02 remains prospective data collection only.
